summary: Security update for the Linux Kernel (Live Patch 78 for SUSE Linux Enterprise 12 SP5)
details:
This update for the SUSE Linux Enterprise kernel 4.12.14-122.296 fixes one security issue

The following security issue was fixed:

- CVE-2026-31431: crypto: algif_aead - Revert to operating out-of-place (bsc#1263689).
